post: ∃ r, ret = .int 64 r ∧ (s_ = [] → r.toInt = -1) ∧ (s_ ≠ [] → 0 ≤ r.toInt ∧ r.toInt < 256)
prelude:
set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
theorem dp_strLen' (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (o l : BitVec 64) :
    denotePure or h .strLen [.str r o l] = .ok (.int 64 l) := by
  rfl

theorem strBytes_head (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (x : BitVec 8) (xs : List (BitVec 8))
    (hh : h[r]? = some (.arr ((x :: xs).map (.int 8)))) (hlen : len.toInt = ((x :: xs).length : Nat)) :
    ∃ bs, strBytes h (.str r 0#64 len) = some (x.toNat :: bs) := by
  have hl : len ≠ 0#64 := by
    intro e; subst e; simp at hlen; omega
  have hn : len.toNat ≠ 0 := by
    intro e; apply hl; exact BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq (by simpa using e)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, len.toNat = k + 1 := ⟨len.toNat - 1, by omega⟩
  generalize hlen' : len = L at *
  cases L with
  | ofFin f =>
    simp [strBytes, hh, hk]

set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
theorem dp_strIndex0 (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (x : BitVec 8) (xs : List (BitVec 8))
    (hh : h[r]? = some (.arr ((x :: xs).map (.int 8)))) (hlen : len.toInt = ((x :: xs).length : Nat)) :
    denotePure or h .strIndex [.str r 0#64 len, .int 64 0#64] = .ok (.int 8 x) := by
  obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ := strBytes_head h r len x xs hh hlen
  have hl : (0#64).ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by simp) (by simp at hlen ⊢; omega)
  show (match asIndex (.int 64 0#64), strBytes h (.str r 0#64 len) with
    | some i, some bs =>
      if i.ult len then
        match bs[i.toNat]? with
        | some b => Res.ok (Val.int 8 (BitVec.ofNat 8 b))
        | none => .panic .modelStuck
      else .panic .indexOutOfRange
    | _, _ => .panic .modelStuck) = _
  simp [asIndex, hbs, hl]
proof:
apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f1
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f1 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f1]
  simp only [dp_strLen']
  cases s_ with
  | nil =>
    have hz : s__len = 0#64 := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_toInt_eq; simpa using h_s__len
    subst hz
    simp
    wp_step prog_f1 [f1]
  | cons x xs =>
    have hz : s__len ≠ 0#64 := by
      intro e; subst e; simp at h_s__len; omega
    simp [hz]
    wp_step prog_f1 [f1]
    simp [dp_strIndex0 or0 s.heap s__ref s__len x xs h_s_ h_s__len]
    have := x.isLt
    rw [Int.bmod_def]
    split <;> omega

post: ∃ n, ret = .int 64 n ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ s_.length
prelude:
theorem cb_strLen (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (o l : BitVec 64) :
    denotePure or h .strLen [.str r o l] = Res.ok (.int 64 l) := rfl

theorem cb_strIndex_raw (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (o l i : BitVec 64) :
    denotePure or h .strIndex [.str r o l, .int 64 i] =
    (match asIndex (.int 64 i), strBytes h (.str r o l) with
    | some i, some bs =>
      if i.ult l then
        match bs[i.toNat]? with
        | some b => Res.ok (.int 8 (BitVec.ofNat 8 b))
        | none => Res.panic .modelStuck
      else Res.panic .indexOutOfRange
    | _, _ => Res.panic .modelStuck) := rfl

theorem cb_strBytes (h : Heap Val) (ref : Nat) (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (len : BitVec 64)
    (hl : len.toInt = xs.length) (hh : h[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 8)))) :
    strBytes h (.str ref 0#64 len) = some (xs.map (fun b => b.toNat)) := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  by_cases h0 : len = 0#64
  · subst h0
    have : xs = [] := by
      have : xs.length = 0 := by simpa using hl.symm
      exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp this
    subst this
    simp [strBytes]
  · have hn : len.toNat = xs.length := by
      have := BitVec.toInt_eq_toNat_cond len
      have := len.isLt
      split at * <;> omega
    rw [strBytes.eq_2 _ _ _ _ h0]
    simp [hh, hn, Function.comp_def]
    exact List.take_of_length_le (by simp)

theorem cb_strIndex (or : Oracle) (h : Heap Val) (ref : Nat) (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (len i : BitVec 64)
    (hl : len.toInt = xs.length) (hh : h[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 8))))
    (hi : i.ult len = true) (hix : i.toNat < xs.length) :
    denotePure or h .strIndex [.str ref 0#64 len, .int 64 i] = Res.ok (.int 8 xs[i.toNat]) := by
  rw [cb_strIndex_raw, cb_strBytes h ref xs len hl hh]
  simp [asIndex, hi, hix]

def cbInv (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (c : BitVec 8)
    (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 15 ∧ env[0]? = some (.str ref 0#64 len) ∧ env[1]? = some (.int 8 c) ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 8))) ∧
  ∃ n i : BitVec 64, env[2]? = some (.int 64 n) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧
    0 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt ≤ len.toInt ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ i.toInt

abbrev cbPost (xs : List (BitVec 8)) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun ret _ => ∃ n : BitVec 64, ret = .int 64 n ∧ 0 ≤ n.toInt ∧ n.toInt ≤ xs.length

theorem cb_step (xs : List (BitVec 8)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (c : BitVec 8)
    (hlen : len.toInt = xs.length) :
    ∀ n env s, cbInv xs ref len c env s →
      (∀ env' s', cbInv xs ref len c env' s' → wpPtN prog or0 h0 n ⟨0, 1⟩ (cbPost xs) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 (n + 1) ⟨0, 1⟩ (cbPost xs) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, h0', h1', hh, k, i, h2, h3, hi0, hi1, hk0, hk1⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h0'
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h1'
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h2
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h3
  apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  wp_simp [f0]
  simp [cb_strLen, e0, e3, hsz]
  cases hc : i.slt len
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
    simp [e2, hsz, cbPost]
    omega
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    dsimp only
    have hiu : i.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hi0 hc
    have hin : (i.toNat : Int) = i.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hi0
    have hix : i.toNat < xs.length := by omega
    have hi1' : (i + 1#64).toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    have hk1' : (k + 1#64).toInt = k.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
    simp [cb_strIndex or0 s.heap ref xs len i hlen hh hiu hix, e0, e1, e3, hsz]
    by_cases hx : xs[i.toNat] = c
    · simp only [hx, decide_true]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
      simp [e2, hsz]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
      simp [e3, hsz]
      refine wpPtN_le ?le (ih _ _ ?inv)
      case le => omega
      case inv =>
        refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz, e0], by simp [hsz, e1], hh, k + 1#64, i + 1#64,
          by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
    · simp only [hx, decide_false]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
      simp [e3, hsz]
      refine wpPtN_le ?le (ih _ _ ?inv)
      case le => omega
      case inv =>
        refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz, e0], by simp [hsz, e1], hh, k, i + 1#64,
          by simp [hsz, e2], by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
proof:
have hz : (0#64 : BitVec 64).toInt = 0 := by decide
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f0
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f0]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f0 (cbInv s_ s__ref s__len c) (cb_step s_ s__ref s__len c h_s__len)
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, h_s_, 0#64, 0#64, by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega
